import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
V=np.var(y)
def run(name,f,npar,nstart=40):
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    for _ in range(nstart):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,npar)
        try:
            r=so.least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, method='lm', max_nfev=4000)
        except Exception: continue
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    e=np.mean((f(best.x)-y)**2)/V
    print(name, '%.3e'%e, np.round(best.x,4))
    return best
